normalized.prompt_en: Where is The Legend of Sleepy Hollow based?
normalized.reason: No listed catalog relation captures 'where a literary work is set or based.' entity_to_containing_location is defined as geographic containment of a physical entity, not the setting/basis of a fictional work. work_to_filming_location is for production sites. A new precise relation work_to_setting (specified work -> setting location) is proposed to cover the real-world or fictional geographic location where a work is set or on which it is based.
